pages.text: $(thing)Remote Sensing$()$(br2)A telescope turned round: from orbit, in visible light and infrared and radar, the whole ground at once. Unlocks the Survey Satellite.

$(thing)Insight$(): 120$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Seismology, Observational Astronomy.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Star Field Plate, 4 Survey Map.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A satellite at height h looks down through a telescope of aperture D at light of wavelength λ.
